purpose: Teach: 結び付け/可変/一望/財務諸表/苦心/降格/行きつけ/委嘱

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、証拠を犯人に結び付けて立件されますね
lines.en: The police are remarkable at linking evidence to suspects and pressing charges.
lines.style: Conversational, admiring tone. Measured pace. Settling into each observation like noting something he's thought about. Respectful but not formal.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、可変的な勤務体系で対応されてますね
lines.en: And they manage their schedules flexibly to respond to situations.
lines.style: Continuing the thread. Smooth, agreeable cadence. A nod to practical competence. Building toward something larger.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市内を一望できる監視塔を整備されますね
lines.en: They've even set up watch towers around the city to keep an eye on everything.
lines.style: Light appreciation in the phrasing. Slight emphasis on the scale of it. Warm but straightforward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不正経理の財務諸表を精査されますね
lines.en: And they carefully audit the financial records when fraud is involved.
lines.style: Same steady recognition. No judgment—just noting thoroughness. Quiet respect underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、苦心して解決された事件は印象的でしたね
lines.en: The cases they've solved with real effort—those stick with you.
lines.style: Shift to reflection. Slower. Genuine warmth. The voice of someone recalling something that mattered. Trailing slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不祥事を起こした警察官の降格処分もされますね
lines.en: Even their internal discipline—demoting officers when they step out of line.
lines.style: Return to even-handed observation. Approving undertone without sounding preachy. Even, steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地元の行きつけの飲食店から情報を得られますね
lines.en: They pick up information from the neighborhood restaurants people go to.
lines.style: Slight warmth returning. Almost amused at the practical cleverness. Conversational, natural.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地域防犯指導を有識者に委嘱されますね
lines.en: And they bring in outside experts to teach the community about crime prevention.
lines.style: Closing note of community-mindedness. Warm, genuinely satisfied. Settling into the final thought. Slight breath before the last phrase.
